notes:
Summary: Stalled / closed-lost-ish due to private networking mismatch and internal freeze. Kestrel is a large fintech experimenting with LLM-based conversational support + doc search + risk scoring. They require VPC/PrivateLink connectivity (AWS PrivateLink) with strict egress controls and legal-mandated data residency in us-east-1. Redwood Private timeline did not align with their procurement window; competitor (Anthropic Enterprise) offered PrivateLink/configured VPC endpoints earlier and won pilot.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-09-03: Lead created from webinar (Ava). initial interest: support-agent + search.
- 2025-10-14: Discovery call (Ava + David). Collected high-level latency targets: p95 < 200ms for short chat; bulk embedding throughput 800 reqs/min during batch jobs.
- 2025-11-04: Deep dive with security (ff_2025-11-04_kfl_discussion). Security asked for PrivateLink + SOC2 + KMS + audit logging. Recorded Fireflies link above.
- 2025-12-09: POC scope agreed: 6-week pilot, 2 models (chat + embeddings), VPC endpoint requirement documented in SOW draft (drive doc).
- 2026-01-18: Security review call (ff_2026-01-18_security_review). Kestrel infosec pressed for PrivateLink availability this quarter; Redwood Private roadmap target slipped to H2 in their notes. Jira ticket raised (INFRA-6789) to explore PrivateLink proxy but no ETA.
- 2026-02-10: Exec budget freeze announced internally at Kestrel; procurement paused. AE informed via email (thread/1729031-security-review).
- 2026-02-24: Competitor update: Anthropic offered managed PrivateLink + audit bundle; Kestrel started vendor comparison (KFL-1234).
- 2026-02-28: Account marked stalled in CRM. AE notes "closed-lost to Anthropic for pilot; keep warm; re-evaluate when our PrivateLink roadmap firm." 

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We can't accept any public internet egress — legal requirement for trading desk data." (infosec lead)
- "If PrivateLink isn't available by Q1, we have to go with a vendor that can do it now." (head of platform)

POC details / requirements that mattered:
- VPC/PrivateLink (mandatory), ability to terminate inside customer's VPC or via AWS PrivateLink.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM for provisioning.
- Audit logs with 13 month retention and tamper-evident storage.
- KMS integration for key control.
- Data residency in us-east-1 and strict egress deny-list.

Why lost / stalled:
- Private networking mismatch: Redwood Private roadmap for PrivateLink/proxy did not meet Kestrel's timeline.
- Security signoff delay amplified by legal/regulatory constraints.
- Budget freeze removed immediate buying pressure; no strong internal champion to keep procurement moving.
- Competitor offered an immediate, certified PrivateLink solution and contract terms.

Next steps / playbook suggestions:
- Keep on quarterly cadence (email + bi-quarterly security update). Re-open when Redwood Private PrivateLink milestone firmed.
- File lessons learned: accelerate PrivateLink comms, produce a one-pager covering interim architectures (limited-scope PrivateLink proxy vs full Private deployment) and compliance controls.
- Suggested follow-up owner: David (SE) to draft a minimal-viable-architecture doc and estimated ETA for PrivateLink support if prioritized.

Internal attachments / refs: drive links above; Jira INFRA-6789 for engineering exploration; KFL-1234 is vendor comparison ticket.

CRM tone notes: concise, somewhat choppy; representative of AE/SE handoff. Marked as low-touch until roadmap moves or Kestrel re-engages.
